description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'parallel-checkout' functionality of a Git extension or tool. It defines multiple test cases to verify that parallel checkout correctly handles file attributes, encoding conversions, end-of-line conversions, external filters, and delayed processing, by setting up repositories, applying configurations, and asserting expected file contents after checkout.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Configures checkout parameters, such as number of workers and other options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares text or general file content.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Performs checkout with specified number of workers.

methods.name: write_utf16
methods.description: Writes UTF-16 encoded data to a file.
